product_metadata.title: Elaine Karen 100% Cotton WASHCLOTHS, 24pc Set, Colors May Vary Bulk
features: 100% COTTON RINGSPUN - Pack of 24 cotton washcloth towel that are soft absorbent, and perfect for every kind of use. The towels are made with loops on both sides to create the extra surface for complete drying. The towels are soft and comfortable to touch and made for your maximum comfort absorbency and durability.

BEST CONVENIENT TOWEL – This towel measures 12” x 12”. These small towels are practical for multiple uses such as salons, face wash, message, automotive, carpeting, polishing chrome, dusting dash boards and wax removal. This can also be used as a towel to wash your bathrooms, and around your house. The pure white color allows for all kind of use.

LONG LASTING QUALITY– Looped terry design is extra absorbent and retains moisture. You would find these towels at every spa, pool, resort, home bath or hotel. Professionally hemmed edges are carefully crafted to enhance the towels quality and durability, and to prevent unraveling. These make great gifts for all year round such as birthdays, opening of a Salon, Christmas, collage, summer and for any other occasion.

EASY TO CARE FOR – Woven from 100% cotton, our lightweight towels are absorbent and fast to dry. They are long lasting and towels stand up to multiple wash and dry cycles and the towels will also become softer with every wash; machine wash in warm and non-chlorine bleach when needed; tumble dry gentle.
YOUR SATISFACTION IS GUARANTEED – Not 100% thrilled with the Elaine Karen Washcloth Towels for any reason? Just get in touch with us within 30 days and we’ll send your money back!
